Hi Sarah / Martin —

Thanks again for a great discovery last week. To keep momentum and align on the evaluation cadence, we’d like to run a short MAP sync to:

- Confirm success criteria and evaluation metrics (latency, token cost, quality examples)
- Map internal stakeholders and decision milestones
- Walk through a proposed evaluation plan and timeline that lines up to your procurement window

Proposed 30–45 min slots:
- Thu Jul 2, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Jul 2, 14:00–14:45 PT

Can you confirm which works best and whether you want any additional folks on the call (security, procurement)? I’ve attached a very short draft MAP outline to seed the discussion.

Attachments: Draft_MAP_outline.pdf (1 page — proposed milestones & owners)

If those times don’t work, share a couple of alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
